theme.kittens.goal: Play with a kitten to wake it up… but watch out, it also flips its neighbours!
theme.kittens.hint: Playing with a kitten wakes it up (or puts it back to sleep), along with its 4 neighbours.
theme.kittens.win: All the kittens are awake and full of energy, well done! 🐾
theme.puppies.goal: Play with a puppy to wake it up… but watch out, it also flips its neighbours!
theme.puppies.hint: Playing with a puppy wakes it up (or puts it back to sleep), along with its 4 neighbours.
theme.puppies.win: All the puppies are awake and ready to play, well done! 🐶
theme.grumpy.goal: Pet a cat to make it smile again… but it also changes its neighbours' mood!
theme.grumpy.hint: A cuddle changes the mood of the cat and its 4 neighbours.
theme.grumpy.win: All the cats are smiling, well done! 😸
theme.garden.goal: Water a bud to make it bloom… but watch out, it also changes the flowers next to it!
theme.garden.hint: Watering a flower opens it (or closes it), along with its 4 neighbours.
theme.garden.win: The whole garden is in bloom, well done! 🌸
theme.nightfall.goal: Switch off a star… but watch out, it also flips its neighbours!
theme.nightfall.hint: Switching a star flips it, along with its 4 neighbours.
theme.nightfall.win: All the stars are out, good night!
